label: z/f input in the original phase, boosted by a preceding z/f/b/q/e/u/3/w/0
explanation: Low end of candidate unit 104. It fires almost only while the original sequence is being read (95% of activation mass; it never fires at t=0 and almost never in the copy phase), and mostly at early positions t=1..4. The current input token is the main driver: z (40% of mass, 10.7x lift) and f (31%), with weaker tokens c, e and 3. Whether a z or f actually fires depends on the previous input: it is much more likely after z, f, b, q, e, u, 3, w or 0. The strongest activations are z z at t=1..2, especially when the sequence starts with z or b. Magnitude seems to grow with an early position and with a run of z/f-like tokens. The response looks like a graded mix of current-token and previous-token evidence rather than a clean rule, so z/f after other tokens produces many false positives, and c/e/3 inputs account for many misses. It does not fire on the delimiter, and copy-phase activity is rare and weak.
